title: Animals Change The Land Worksheets | Kindergarten Practice Pack
desc:
📚 Standards aligned: K-ESS2-2

Give your learners extra practice with Animals Change The Land! This no-prep printable pack has 3 practice pages plus a 1-page answer key for grown-ups. Just print and go.

WHAT'S INSIDE (6 pages)

  • Cover page
  • How Animals Change Their Homes
  • Made by Animals or People?
  • Busy Beaver
  • Answer key (1 page): every answer, plus "Say" lines for listening pages
  • Terms of use

PERFECT FOR

  • Morning work, centers and small groups
  • Homework, early finishers and review
  • Homeschool lessons and summer practice

WHY TEACHERS LOVE IT

  • Clear directions young learners can follow
  • Friendly pictures that match each word
  • Listening pages keep the words in the answer key, so children truly listen
  • Each page matches a game on Creative Sprout Learning (How Animals Change Their Homes, Made by Animals or People?, Busy Beaver), so children can play, then print and practice
